snippet.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2026 - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is the best bowling game ever. Fully rebuilt from the ground up, it features a reimagined Career Mode, character customization, new character art, improved graphics, online play, advanced physics, and oil pattern breakdown - plus new game modes, venues, pros, balls, and more. Experience all the action when the game releases later this year!

Sign up for early access to the game's alpha:
https://probowling.com/

Join our Discord for discussion, announcements, and sneak peaks:
https://discord.gg/pba

Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3127230/PBA_Pro_Bowling_2026/

See you on the lanes in Q4 of 2025!
